title: LDI Data Readiness & Integration Gaps (Real Database)
description: Evidence-based readiness dashboard using only current PostgreSQL rows. No simulated data.

list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data ORDER BY factory
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data ORDER BY factory

list.name: machine_id
list.label: Machine
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) ORDER BY eqp_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) ORDER BY eqp_id

panels.title: Telemetry Age
panels.description: Hours since the latest real telemetry row. Green is under 1 hour; red is over 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX("time"))) / 3600.0, 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Alarm Age
panels.description: Hours since the latest real alarm row for selected telemetry machines.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(logdate))) / 3600.0, 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
WHERE eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Machine ID Match
panels.description: Percent of selected telemetry machine IDs also found in alarm history.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a WHERE a.equipmentid = s.eqp_id)
) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value
FROM selected s;

panels.title: Alarm Master Match
panels.description: Percent of real alarm rows whose error code can be resolved by the current alarm master.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.alarm_code IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Board ID Completeness
panels.description: Percent of telemetry rows with a non-null board_id.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(board_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: PE / JE4 Coverage
panels.description: Row-level completeness of PE and JE4 for selected machines.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(pe_1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "PE",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(je_4) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "JE4"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring});

panels.title: Telemetry Ingestion Rows by Machine
panels.description: Actual telemetry rows received in each five-minute bucket. Gaps indicate no stored rows, not simulated downtime.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_bin('5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS "time",
  eqp_id AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Machine Data Coverage Matrix
panels.description: Real row counts and field coverage per selected machine.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
WITH alarm_counts AS (
  SELECT equipmentid AS eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS alarm_rows, MAX(logdate) AS last_alarm
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
  GROUP BY equipmentid
)
SELECT
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  MIN(d.factory) AS "Factory",
  MIN(d.process) AS "Process",
  COUNT(*) AS "Telemetry Rows",
  MAX(d."time") AS "Latest Telemetry",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.pe_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "PE %",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "JE1-3 %",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_4) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "JE4 %",
  COALESCE(MAX(a.alarm_rows), 0) AS "Alarm Rows",
  MAX(a.last_alarm) AS "Latest Alarm"
FROM public.ldi_data d
LEFT JOIN alarm_counts a ON a.equipmentid = d.eqp_id
WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY d.eqp_id
ORDER BY d.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Machine ID Mapping Gaps (Global)
panels.description: Global comparison of machine identifiers in telemetry and alarm sources. This intentionally ignores dashboard filters so unmatched IDs stay visible.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
WITH telemetry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
), alarms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid AS eqp_id FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
), ids AS (
  SELECT eqp_id FROM telemetry
  UNION
  SELECT eqp_id FROM alarms
)
SELECT
  i.eqp_id AS "Machine ID",
  (t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL) AS "In Telemetry",
  (a.equipmentid IS NOT NULL) AS "In Alarm",
  CASE
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL AND a.equipmentid IS NOT NULL THEN 'MATCHED'
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NULL THEN 'ALARM ONLY'
    ELSE 'TELEMETRY ONLY'
  END AS "Mapping Status"
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN telemetry t USING (eqp_id)
LEFT JOIN alarms a USING (eqp_id)
ORDER BY "Mapping Status", i.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Alarm Code Mapping Gaps (Global)
panels.description: Every distinct alarm code from the real log and whether it resolves against the supplied alarm master.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT
  a.errorcode::TEXT AS "Alarm Code",
  COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
  CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MATCHED' END AS "Mapping",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, '') AS "Message",
  COALESCE(m.alarm_type, '') AS "Severity"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
GROUP BY a.errorcode, m.alarm_code, m.alarm_msg, m.alarm_type
ORDER BY "Rows" DESC
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Board Event Data Quality
panels.description: Shows why telemetry rows cannot yet be treated as guaranteed board-completion events: board_id is missing and some MO + board_no keys repeat.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT
  eqp_id AS "Machine",
  COUNT(*) AS "Telemetry Rows",
  COUNT(DISTINCT (mo, board_no)) AS "Unique MO + Board No",
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (mo, board_no)) AS "Duplicate Board Keys",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(board_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Board ID %",
  COUNT(DISTINCT mo) AS "Distinct MO",
  MIN(board_no) AS "Min Board No",
  MAX(board_no) AS "Max Board No"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY eqp_id
ORDER BY "Duplicate Board Keys" DESC, eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Inferred Sensor / Source Capability
panels.description: Capability is inferred only from existing rows. ALL ZERO or CONSTANT means verify the machine specification; it is not automatically classified as a fault.

targets.rawSql:
-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.pe_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "PE1-6",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE1-3",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_4) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE4",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.air_vacuum) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.air_vacuum) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    WHEN BOOL_AND(d.air_vacuum = 0) THEN 'ALL ZERO - VERIFY'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Vacuum",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.scan_speed) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.scan_speed) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Scan Speed",
  CASE WHEN MAX(a.equipmentid) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO MATCHING ID' END AS "Alarm Source"
FROM public.ldi_data d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid AS eqp_id FROM public.ldi_alarm_log) a ON a.equipmentid = d.eqp_id
WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY d.eqp_id
ORDER BY d.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

options.content:
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;600;800&display=swap');

@keyframes gradientBG {
    0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

@keyframes edgeGlow {
    0% { border-color: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }
    50% { border-color: rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.2), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 135, 0.05); }
    100% { border-color: rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }
}

/* Global Background */
.main-view, .react-grid-layout, .dashboard-container, body {
    background: linear-gradient(-45deg, #0b0f19, #141416, #090a0f, #1a1525) !important;
    background-size: 400% 400% !important;
    animation: gradientBG 15s ease infinite !important;
}

/* Panel Backgrounds (Ultra Glassmorphism) */
.panel-container {
    background: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.6) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-radius: 16px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%);
    transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
}

/* Hover effect */
.panel-container:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.01);
    animation: edgeGlow 3s infinite !important;
    z-index: 100;
}

/* Typography overriding */
.panel-title-text, .grafana-tooltip, text, div {
    font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Header colors */
.panel-title-text {
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: 1px !important;
    font-size: 18px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: -webkit-linear-gradient(45deg, #00F2FE, #00FF87);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

/* Scrollbar hiding for clean look */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); 
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #00F2FE, #7F00FF); 
    border-radius: 10px;
}

/* Hide the injector panel itself */
div[data-panelid="9999"] { display: none !important; }
</style>
